status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
This test is still failing during interop testing with master servers against both b2_15 clients (known issue LU-18320 that disabled this teseting), and b2_16 clients which should have patch https://review.whamcloud.com/ 56839 ("LU-18320 tests: add skip option to sanity-lnet test_226") and should be irrelevant because the peer version is 2.17.51.

The nterop testing started failing 100% between 2025-08-20 and 2025-08-26:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/search?client_branch=b2_16&server_branch=master&test_set_script_id=a2b1c4b2-b449-11e9-b88c-52540065bddc&sub_test_script_id=5519abee-0e0a-4573-b594-f1bcdfa8ae66&start_date=2025-08-10&end_date=2025-08-27&source=sub_tests#redirect

LNet-related patches landed in that window are:

98c6b29359 LU-18444 lnet: Remove per-peer health sensitivity
70c5f58403 LU-18444 lnet: Use only NI status for route aliveness
c892edc14a LU-18555 lnet: Track successful and failed resends
ed70ccb471 LU-15135 lnet: Graceful router removal and addition
ce620cfffa LU-19248 tests: Wait for fake intf ipv6 dup detection
144da866d6 LU-19159 lnet: Handle ip2nets in jt_import

and the most likely candidate appears to be patch https://review.whamcloud.com/57490 ("LU-15135 lnet: Graceful router removal and addition"), commit v2_16_57-110-ged70ccb471, which is modifying the same check_route_aliveness() function that test_226 is using, but I don't know exactly what is wrong or how to fix it.

hornc could you please comment. Should this subtest just be skipped in interop testing with peers < v2_16_57-110-ged70ccb471, or is there value to testing the router handling in interop?

"Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/64531
Subject: LU-19385 tests: skip sanity-lnet/226 for old client
Project: fs/lustre-release
Branch: master
Current Patch Set: 1
Commit: 0d4e3407207da3f4ac6445eade55ea4fa31bead4

The patch is excepting test_226 for < 2.16 clients (LU-18320) but it doesn't yet do anything to fix interop testing with 2.16 clients. I did add more debugging into the test case to see what is going on. Depending on what Chris reports, the sanity-lnet.ex entry could be increased in my patch to exclude clients older than v2_16_57-110-ged70ccb471. The interop testing with newer clients and older servers appear to be passing without issue.

ssmirnov could you please comment if this test interop failure is expected for older clients and should just be skipped for clients < v2_16_57-110-ged70ccb471 (i.e. test script issue or old client is lacking some functionality needed for the test), or is there a real bug here?
